chunks: Al-Hajjal narrated from Dawud ibn Abi Yazid, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
A man said to him: "I have come upon some wealth, and I have feared for myself concerning it. If I were to find its owner, I would hand it over to him and be rid of it."
He said to him: "Then by Allah, if you were to find him, would you hand it over to him?"
He عليه السلام said: "Then no, by Allah, it has no owner other than me."
He said: And he made him swear that he would deliver it to whomever he instructed him. He said: So he swore.
He said: "Go and divide it among your brothers, and you shall have safety regarding what you feared." He said: So he divided it among his brothers.

key_terms.إِخْوَانِكَ: your brothers, meaning fellow believers or close community members
key_terms.اسْتَحْلَفَهُ: he made him swear an oath
key_terms.الْأَمَانُ: safety or security from the feared consequence
key_terms.تَخَلَّصْتُ: I would free myself from responsibility for it
key_terms.صَاحِبَهُ: its owner, the one to whom the property would ordinarily belong
key_terms.مَالًا: wealth or property that the man had come upon

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام instruct a person to do with disputed or found wealth?
ai.summary: This hadith relates a ruling concerning wealth whose rightful disposal was referred to Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام. After the man affirmed his willingness to return it to its owner, the Imam عليه السلام directed him to distribute it among his brothers, granting him safety from what he feared. The narration reflects the Imam’s religious authority over such property and its redistribution.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4063 - Al-Hajjal narrated from Dawud ibn Abi Yazid, from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
A man said to Imam (as): "I have come across some wealth, and I fear for my safety because of it. If I were to find its owner, I would return it to him and be free from it."
Imam (as) said to him, "By Allah (swt), if you were to find its owner, would you truly return it to him?"
Imam (as) then said: "By Allah (swt), it has no owner other than me."

Imam (as) then made the man swear to distribute it as Imam (as) instructed.
The man swore,
and Imam (as) said: "Go and distribute it among your brothers, and you are safe from what you feared." So, the man divided it among his brothers.
